item.title: Bilateral Maritime Trade Accord Signed at Geneva Summit
item.description: Trade delegates finalized tariff exemptions for renewable energy components following six months of multilateral negotiations in Geneva. Harbor customs protocols take effect next month.
item.dc:creator: Geneva Bureau

item.title: Central Bank Governor Holds Benchmarks Steady at Autumn Review
item.description: The governing council voted unanimously to maintain baseline interest rates while noting cooling headline inflation figures across core industrial sectors.
item.dc:creator: Finance Desk
